title: Agent Dashboards Deck Two
brands: Agent Dashboards Deck Two: board-specific layout choices for UpKeep (internal board), Deck Building, Branding, Legal, Blog, Dump, Japan Cottage, Video & Photo, Jokes, Miles, WellNest, Portfolio, plus the Routines section (R65)

White page (beige #FAF6EE accents), white cards, Khand/Hind, terracotta/lagoon/jungle/saffron accents; skips everything settled in the Dashboard Rulebook (R1-R65) and earlier board decks; text at least 8 units, vector mockups
